review_highlights.comment: The professor is all about interaction. She is helpful and with a good attitude. If the class is not ready to move on, she does not push the material. This class definitely took up all of my free time. Read an average of 2 chapters per week, wrote 5 or 6 papers, did about 4 presentations, and took about 5 exams. It is a lot of work, but if you put the effort in, you will get a good grade. Alameddin is a delight and she is always happy to be in class with you. Her class is hard, but she is great.

She really cares about her students, I improved a lot!

She gives a lot of handouts, which are vital to my understanding of the material, and is super helpful! She is always there for her students, and is obviously passionate about her students. The homework is very crucial to making an A, and she will not rest until you understand the lessons. She is always available and is super sweet!

Hands down, she is the best french teacher i've ever had. She speaks in french most of the time, but she is happy to clarify something for you if needed. Yes, there is a lot of homework but she is easy on the grading. Plus, if you do the work you'll do fine on the test. If you are truly interested in learning french, take this class!

He definitely helped me and the entire class by curving grades and always rounding upward. He also takes questions straight from the homework for the tests, which he posts the correct answers online prior to.

If you show up, pay attention, and stay engaged, you'll get a lot out of the course. His explanations are clear, his expectations are reasonable, and you can tell he genuinely wants the class to succeed. Do the homework, study a bit, and you'll be in good shape. I'd definitely take another class with him.

He keeps the class organized, explains things in a calm way, and doesn't rush through the material. Overall, a smooth class.
